notes.title: New difficulty balance
notes.notes:
Hello community!

Thank you very much for all the feedback, especially about the excessive difficulty of the game. Please be advised that a difficulty smoothing patch is now available with a number of improvements:

[list]
[*] Added 4 more seconds to horde fire resistance
[*] Decreased fire rate of soldiers by 25%
[*] Reduced the number of mines in all stages
[*] Reduced the number of firing soldiers grouped together
[*] New difficulty rate for the first stages
[*] New difficulty balance for all stages
[/list]

We apologize for what happened and hope that you can continue to support us and that you have the opportunity to replay our game with this new difficulty balance. If you haven't already, please consider giving us feedback in a review. We can only better improve the game if you continue giving feedback, plus it really helps us out!

Thank you!

https://indie.live-expo.games/en/

As you get to playing, [b]don’t forget to leave us a review here on Steam[/b]🙂 We always love getting to hear player feedback, plus it really helps us out. If your zombie horde runs into any bugs, feel free to throw as much information as you can about it in this Steam discussion thread for bug reporting.

notes.title: Publisher Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

We’re excited to announce that They Are Coming is now being published by Freedom Games ( https://www.freedom.gg/ )! 

For those of you who may not know, a game publisher not only provides additional investment and funding for developing the game, but also takes care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing our store page, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. It really lets us totally focus on working to make the game the best it can be as we go through Early Access, and provides us with the resources to do so.

Thank you all for your support so far throughout development! While you’re here, don’t forget to wishlist the game here on Steam!
